title: Có ai nói được tiếng Anh không?
englishTitle: Is there someone who speaks English?
pronunciation: Co ai noi duoc tieng Anh khong
summary: For politely asking for an English speaking handoff when the exchange is stuck.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Repeating, pointing, or translation has not solved the conversation.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Ask calmly at the counter or desk. The answer may be a staff handoff, a phone call, or a polite no.

phrases.vietnamese: Có ai nói được tiếng Anh không?
phrases.english: Is there someone who speaks English?
phrases.pronunciation: Co ai noi duoc tieng Anh khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Có ai asks is there anyone; nói được tiếng Anh means who can speak English; không makes it a yes/no question.

breakdown.vietnamese: Có ai nói được tiếng Anh không?
breakdown.english: Is there someone who speaks English?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: I do not understand, slower speech, and polite slower speech phrases help before asking for a full handoff.

phrases.english: Can you speak a little slower?

phrases.vietnamese: Nói chậm giúp tôi được không?
phrases.english: Could you speak a little slower, please?
phrases.pronunciation: noy chuhm zoop toy dook khong

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotels, clinics, transport counters, police desks, pharmacies, and service counters.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If no one speaks English, switch to writing, pointing, or a translation app instead of repeating louder.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Explain in English, translation app, type into my phone, write the address, and translate-this phrases cover the next repair path.
